title: Trump Addresses 2028 Presidential Ambitions, Cites Legal Constraints
summary: Former US President Donald Trump has commented on the possibility of running for president again in 2028. He expressed a desire to serve a third term, stating, "My heart wants to be president a third time." However, Trump also indicated that legal restrictions would prevent him from doing so, noting, "The law is very strong." He made these remarks when asked about his intentions for the upcoming US presidential election.
summary_points: Donald Trump expressed a desire to run for president in 2028.
He stated his "heart wants to be president a third time."
Trump cited legal constraints, saying "the law is very strong."
He made these comments when asked about the upcoming US election.

summary_hi: पूर्व अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प ने 2028 में फिर से राष्ट्रपति चुनाव लड़ने की संभावना पर टिप्पणी की है। उन्होंने तीसरी बार राष्ट्रपति बनने की इच्छा व्यक्त करते हुए कहा, "मेरा दिल तीसरी बार राष्ट्रपति बनना चाहता है।" हालांकि, ट्रम्प ने यह भी संकेत दिया कि कानूनी प्रतिबंध उन्हें ऐसा करने से रोकेंगे, यह कहते हुए कि "कानून बहुत सख्त है।" उन्होंने आगामी अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति चुनाव के बारे में पूछे जाने पर ये टिप्पणियां कीं।
